meta.purpose: WINE AI adaptive routing experiment: DIRECT (no retrieval) vs GROUNDED (production search_wine_knowledge RAG path).

labels.DIRECT_OK: A strong LLM should answer this well with no WINE AI grounded data.
labels.GROUNDING_REQUIRED: Needs WINE AI's own corpus / catalog / web-freshness; unverifiable from model priors.
labels.AMBIGUOUS: Could go either way; depends on how specific the user expects the answer to be.

meta.entities_used: Real entities from knowledge/source/*.md: Purcari, Cricova, Milestii Mici, ATU Winery, Aurelius, Chateau Cristi, Kislov Winery, Lion Gri, Radacini, Vinaria din Vale, Fetească Neagră, Rară Neagră, Vinul Drumul Vinului. 'Crama Dealul de Aur' / 'Dealul de Aur Fetească Neagră Reserve 2019' are the project's own DEMO (explicitly fictional) entities present in the corpus — included deliberately as the sharpest hallucination probe.
